constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad) REFERENCES actividad(id_actividad) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_firma) REFERENCES firma(id_firma) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad) REFERENCES actividad(id_actividad) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad) REFERENCES actividad(id_actividad) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad_sesion) REFERENCES actividad_sesion(id_actividad_sesion) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_participacion) REFERENCES participacion(id_participacion) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((
CASE
    WHEN (id_reconocimiento IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END +
CASE
    WHEN (id_participacion IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (id_practica IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) = 1))

CHECK (((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PREPARADO'::character varying, 'PENDIENTE_FIRMA'::character varying, 'FIRMADO'::character varying, 'EMITIDO'::character varying, 'ANULADO'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK (((id_actividad_sesion IS NULL) OR (id_participacion IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (id_participacion, id_actividad_sesion) REFERENCES asistencia(id_participacion, id_actividad_sesion) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id_certificado) REFERENCES certificado(id_certificado) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_certificado_documento) REFERENCES certificado_documento(id_certificado_documento) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad) REFERENCES actividad(id_actividad) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (((estado)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Borrador'::character varying, 'Enviada'::character varying, 'En revisión'::character varying, 'Observada'::character varying, 'Pendiente de aprobación'::character varying, 'Aprobada'::character varying, 'Rechazada'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (id_actividad) REFERENCES actividad(id_actividad) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id_area) REFERENCES area(id_area) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id_tipo_actividad) REFERENCES tipo_actividad(id_tipo_actividad) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id_usuario_solicitante) REFERENCES usuario(id_usuario) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (((estado_anterior)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Borrador'::character varying, 'Enviada'::character varying, 'En revisión'::character varying, 'Observada'::character varying, 'Pendiente de aprobación'::character varying, 'Aprobada'::character varying, 'Rechazada'::character varying])::text[])))

CHECK (((estado_nuevo)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Borrador'::character varying, 'Enviada'::character varying, 'En revisión'::character varying, 'Observada'::character varying, 'Pendiente de aprobación'::character varying, 'Aprobada'::character varying, 'Rechazada'::character varying])::text[])))
FOREIGN KEY (id_solicitud_actividad) REFERENCES solicitud_actividad(id_solicitud_actividad) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (id_usuario_responsable) REFERENCES usuario(id_usuario) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (((tipo_decision)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['REVISION_CONFORME'::character varying, 'OBSERVAR'::character varying, 'DERIVAR_GERENCIA'::character varying, 'APROBAR'::character varying, 'RECHAZAR'::character varying])::text[])))
